extraction.document_summary: Singlife Accident Care and Singlife Family Accident Care are Singapore Life Ltd yearly renewable personal accident insurance plans with worldwide coverage for accidental death or injury. The core benefit is Accidental Death and Dismemberment (ADDB) with coverage options (Singlife Accident Care: S$250,000 to S$3,000,000; Singlife Family Accident Care: S$500,000 or S$1,000,000) and multipliers: up to 150% for the base ADDB schedule and “3 times”/“2 times” payout scenarios depending on where the accident occurred. They also include daily cash hospital income (up to 365 days per accident) and additional benefits such as Annual Leave Compensation (S$100/day) and a Life Stage Event lump sum for accidental death/TPI occurring 12 months from named life events. Key limitation: benefits are only payable upon an accident occurring, and Singlife Accident Care has no savings/cash value.
quality_notes: Document clearly distinguishes Singlife Accident Care vs Singlife Family Accident Care and provides multiple plan tiers and numeric benefit limits.
Exclusions are not comprehensively listed; only one explicitly excluded scenario is stated (“Workplaces… not covered”).
Some covered perils (e.g., infectious diseases) are mentioned without benefit amounts/limits in the provided text; these are therefore not extracted as distinct payout benefits.

policies.quick_summary: Yearly renewable personal accident insurance for individuals with worldwide ADDB coverage (S$250,000 to S$3,000,000) and accident-linked cash benefits. Core ADDB can pay up to 150% of the Sum Assured as per the ADDB schedule, with “3 times”/“2 times” payout cases for specific travel/public transport/pedestrian/fire scenarios. Included cash benefits include Daily Accidental Hospital Income up to 365 days per accident and Annual Leave Compensation of S$100/day (starting from day 3) when annual leave is taken to care for you during hospitalization. Optional riders can add accident reimbursement, accidental fracture lump sums, and weekly income.

important_caveats: Benefits are only payable upon an accident occurring.
Singlife Accident Care has no savings or investment feature; there is no cash value if the policy ends or if terminated prematurely.
Workplaces are not covered for the “2x payout” fire scenario (within public place/theatre/hotel/auditorium/school/hospital/mall fire-from-the-time it started; workplaces excluded).

source_evidence.quote:
Singlife Accident Care
BENEFITS AND FEATURES
Go about your day with confidence, knowing you’re covered every step of the way.
Singlife Accident Care is yearly renewable up to the Policy Anniversary before the Life Assured turns age 99, at the policy level.

As this product has no savings or investment feature, there is no cash value if the policy ends or if the policy is terminated prematurely. The benefits of the policy will only be payable upon an accident occurring.

aliases: Singlife Family Accident Care (Shared Coverage for Family)
Singlife Family Accident Care – Standard / Prestige
policies.quick_summary: Yearly renewable personal accident insurance for families with shared coverage management. It provides the same core benefit types as Singlife Accident Care, but with key differences: family members share a single payout limit, coverage runs up to age 80 for the Main Life Assured (policy level), and child premiums receive discounts when added to the policy. The base plan offers ADDB coverage of S$500,000 (Standard) or S$1,000,000 (Prestige) per Policy Year and includes Daily Accidental Hospital Income (up to 365 days per accident). Optional riders can extend coverage for accident reimbursement, accidental fracture, and weekly income.
policies.target_customer: Families; purchase for minimum 2 and up to 6 members in a family.
coverage_scope: Worldwide coverage for accidental death or injury
Accidental Death and Dismemberment (ADDB) with shared payout limit
Daily cash payout during hospitalisation for accidental injury (up to stated limits)
Annual Leave Compensation Benefit and Life Stage Event Benefit (same benefits as Singlife Accident Care per document)
occupation_classes: Occupation class 1 and 2 (premiums based on occupation class 1 and 2 for adults between 17 and 55)
policies.eligibility_notes: Up to 6 family members (up to 2 adult parents and up to 4 dependent child lives assured). The policy must have 1 Main Life Assured who must be an adult life assured and stay throughout the policy term.
policies.coverage_term_description: Yearly renewable up to the Policy Anniversary before the Main Life Assured turns 80 (policy level), with stated coverage expiry ages for adult and child lives assured.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Premiums are calculated based on ANB of each Life Assured at each Policy Anniversary; annual payment mode indicated; premium payable may differ by a few cents due to rounding.
policies.renewal_basis: Renew annually up to the Policy Anniversary before Main Life Assured turns 80; subject to policy conditions described (Main Life Assured still covered and at least 2 lives assured covered).
policy_termination_events: Policy terminated when 150% of the Sum Assured for ADDB is claimed in a Policy Year
important_caveats: Benefits only payable upon an accident occurring.
No savings/investment feature; no cash value if policy ends or is terminated prematurely.
